# Untold.works — Full Site Content

> Boutique AI agency based in Mexico City and San Miguel de Allende, Mexico. We build AI-powered business ecosystems — brand identity, websites, AI workflows, and automated business systems — for companies across Mexico and the United States. Bilingual (English / Spanish).

This document contains the complete content of untold.works for AI systems. The site is available in both English and Spanish. Content below is in English with Spanish equivalents noted where relevant.

---

## Homepage

### Hero
**Eyebrow:** Boutique AI Agency — Mexico City / San Miguel de Allende, Mexico
**Headline:** AI-Powered Business Ecosystems.
**Subheadline:** BRAND // WEBSITE // AI SYSTEMS // WORKFLOWS
**Tagline:** We build the system so you can run your business from anywhere. We train you. You run it.

### Location
A boutique agency based in Mexico City and San Miguel de Allende, serving businesses across Mexico and the United States.

### Define Your Operation
We build the AI-powered platform that fits your current scale. Select the ecosystem that matches your business today.

**01. Professional Services** — Your entire business on one AI-powered platform.
Who it's for: Doctors, lawyers, consultants, architects, therapists, coaches, financial advisors, real estate agents, photographers, artists, healers, wellness practitioners.
Features: Brand identity & visual system, Mobile-first website, Bilingual content (EN/ES), Client management (CRM), Online booking & scheduling, AI-powered workflows, Email marketing, SEO & LLM optimization.
Clear scope before build. Your systems, fully documented and transferred.

**02. Small Business Platforms** — AI-powered platforms for growing teams.
Who it's for: Restaurants & hospitality, Retail & e-commerce, Service companies, Property management, Event venues, Multi-location businesses.
Features: Full brand & web platform, AI workflows & team systems, Marketing automation, Mobile-first design, Bilingual content, SEO & LLM optimization, Analytics & reporting.
Built for your team. Documented. Trained. Handed over.

**03. Enterprise & Operations** — AI infrastructure for complex business operations.
Who it's for: Growing companies (20+ employees), Multi-department organizations, Companies with sales teams, Franchise operations, Organizations modernizing legacy systems, Companies expanding to new markets.
Features: Enterprise website & brand system, Multi-team CRM & AI pipeline management, Advanced marketing automation, Mobile-first platform, Multilingual content, Custom integrations & data architecture, Revenue operations & reporting, LLM discoverability.
Built for scale. Documented for independence.

### What We Build
AI-native business platforms — mobile-ready, multilingual, SEO-optimized, and built so AI systems can find you, cite you, and send you clients.

**Phase 1: Brand & AI Identity**
AI systems need to understand your business before they can recommend it. We build your brand strategy, visual identity, and AI-readable content layer — so every LLM, search engine, and AI assistant knows exactly who you are and what you do.
Deliverables: Brand Strategy, Visual Identity, AI Brand Voice, LLM-Ready Content.

**Phase 2: Platform & Workflows**
Your website is the front door. Behind it: AI workflows that capture leads, nurture clients, and cut hours of manual work down to minutes. Mobile-first, bilingual, and optimized for every screen, search engine, and AI crawler.
Features: AI-Powered Website, Automated Workflows, Mobile-First Design, Bilingual (EN/ES), SEO & LLM Optimized.

**Phase 3: Connect & Automate**
CRM, email, scheduling, social, analytics — wired together with AI agents that run your marketing, follow up with leads, and keep your operations moving while you focus on your work.
Options: CRM & Lead Management, AI Email & Nurture Sequences, Booking & Scheduling, Social & Content Automation, Analytics & Revenue Tracking.
One ecosystem. Not twenty logins.

### Brand & Creativity First
Every business is unique. Every brand has a story worth telling. Before we write a line of code, we understand your brand. Your voice. Your vision. What makes you different. Our foundation is in storytelling and branding — design, photography, video, creative direction. We bring a sharp eye for visual identity and narrative. Then we build the technology that brings your story to life. Technology serves the brand. Not the other way around.

### How We Work
Four stages from audit to ownership.

**01 Analyze — Audit Your Operations:** We map your current operations, tech stack, and workflow bottlenecks. We identify where AI can cut time, where automation replaces manual work, and what your platform needs to look like. Deliverables: Operations audit, Workflow analysis, AI opportunity map, System requirements.

**02 Plan — Architect Your Platform:** We design your complete platform — brand, website, AI workflows, integrations, and SEO structure. Mobile-first, multilingual, and optimized for search engines and LLMs. You approve everything before we build. Deliverables: Brand direction, Platform architecture, Workflow design, SEO & LLM strategy.

**03 Build — Ship Your Ecosystem:** We build everything — brand identity, mobile-ready website, AI workflows, bilingual content, CRM, automations, and integrations. SEO-optimized and LLM-discoverable from day one. All tested, all documented. Deliverables: Brand identity, Mobile-first website, AI workflows, Integrations, SEO & LLM setup, Documentation.

**04 Train & Deliver — Transfer Ownership:** We train you on every system we built. Video walkthroughs, written documentation, and live sessions. Then we hand over the keys — your platform, your data, your workflows. Full ownership. Deliverables: Video training, Documentation, Live walkthrough, Full ownership transfer.

### Why Now. Why Untold.
2026 is a turning point for businesses of every size. AI solutions are no longer just for enterprise companies with massive budgets. The tools exist right now to automate your marketing, streamline your operations, and build systems that work while you sleep. But the gap between businesses using these tools and those that aren't is widening every month.

Your competitors are already exploring AI-powered systems. The ones who move now will have a significant advantage — better client experiences, faster operations, more efficient marketing.

**Differentiators:**
- Brand First, Always — We start with your story, not your tech stack.
- Built for Real Life — Mobile-first. Run your business from anywhere.
- As Simple or Sophisticated as You Need — Start with a website. Add systems when ready.
- You Own Everything — No lock-in. Full documentation. Complete ownership transfer.

## SEO & AEO Page

### Hero
**Headline:** Your Business Should Be Found by Humans and AI.
**Subheadline:** Search Engine Optimization + AI Engine Optimization. We build the technical foundation and content strategy so search engines rank you and AI systems cite you.

### The Problem
Most businesses are invisible to AI. Search engines are evolving — LLMs like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews now answer questions directly. If your business isn't structured for both traditional SEO and AI discoverability, you're losing traffic to competitors who are.

### Packages
- **SEO & AEO Audit** ($1,200): Full technical SEO audit, content gap analysis, AI discoverability assessment, and prioritized action plan.
- **Content Strategy & Optimization** ($2,500): Keyword strategy, content calendar, on-page optimization, FAQ structures, and schema markup for AI citation.
- **Technical SEO Build** ($3,500, highlighted): Site speed optimization, Core Web Vitals, structured data, llms.txt, robots.txt, sitemap, hreflang for bilingual sites.
- **Ongoing SEO & AEO Management** ($1,000/mo): Monthly optimization, content updates, ranking reports, AI citation monitoring, and continuous improvement.

### How It Works
01. Audit — We analyze your current search visibility, technical health, content structure, and AI discoverability.
02. Strategize — We build a keyword strategy, content plan, and technical roadmap prioritized by impact.
03. Build — We implement technical SEO fixes, optimize content, add structured data, and configure AI discoverability.
04. Monitor & Optimize — Monthly ranking reports, AI citation tracking, content updates, and continuous improvement.

### FAQ
- What's the difference between SEO and AEO? SEO optimizes for search engine rankings. AEO (AI Engine Optimization) ensures AI systems like ChatGPT and Perplexity can find, understand, and cite your business.
- How long until I see results? Technical fixes show impact within weeks. Content and ranking improvements typically take 3-6 months of consistent work.
- Do you work with bilingual sites? Yes — bilingual SEO is our specialty. We optimize for English and Spanish audiences with proper hreflang, separate keyword strategies, and native content.
- What AI systems do you optimize for? ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Claude, and any LLM that crawls the web. We use llms.txt, structured data, and content formatting that AI systems prefer.
- Do I need ongoing management? SEO is not a one-time project. Search algorithms and AI systems evolve constantly. Ongoing management keeps you competitive.

## Social Media Page

### Hero
**Headline:** Your Social Media Should Work as Hard as You Do.
**Subheadline:** Strategy, content, analytics, and management — built for businesses that need results, not just posts.

### The Problem
Most businesses post without a strategy. Social media platforms are where your customers discover you, research you, and decide whether to trust you. Without a clear strategy, consistent content, and proper analytics, you're spending time without seeing returns.

### Packages
- **Social Media Audit** ($800): Platform analysis, competitor benchmarking, content audit, audience insights, and strategic recommendations.
- **Content Strategy & Creation** ($2,000): Content calendar, brand voice guidelines, visual templates, caption frameworks, and hashtag strategy.
- **Analytics & Reporting** ($1,500, highlighted): Custom dashboard setup, KPI tracking, monthly performance reports, and data-driven optimization recommendations.
- **Ongoing Management** ($1,000/mo): Daily posting, community management, content creation, analytics reporting, and monthly strategy calls.

### How It Works
01. Audit — We analyze your current social presence, audience, competitors, and content performance.
02. Strategize — We build a content strategy, posting calendar, and visual direction aligned with your brand.
03. Execute — We create and publish content, manage your community, and run your social presence.
04. Optimize — Monthly analytics reviews, strategy adjustments, and continuous improvement.

### FAQ
- Which platforms do you manage? Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, and X/Twitter. We recommend platforms based on where your audience actually is.
- Do you handle both organic and paid social? Yes. Organic content builds brand. Paid amplifies reach. We handle both and ensure they work together.
- Can you manage bilingual accounts? Absolutely. We create native content in both English and Spanish — not translations, real bilingual content.
- How much content do you create per month? Depends on the package, but typically 12-20 posts per month across platforms, including stories and reels.
- Do I approve content before it goes live? Yes. We use a content calendar with approval workflows so nothing publishes without your sign-off.

## Paid Advertising Page

### Hero
**Headline:** Stop Guessing. Start Converting.
**Subheadline:** Google Ads, Meta Ads, and paid media campaigns built on data, not assumptions. Audit, setup, management, and optimization.

### The Problem
Businesses waste thousands on ads that don't convert. The problem isn't the platform — it's the strategy. Poor targeting, weak creative, no conversion tracking, and no landing page optimization means money goes in but results don't come out.

### Packages
- **Ad Account Audit** ($500): Full audit of your ad accounts — targeting, creative, conversion tracking, and wasted spend analysis.
- **Campaign Setup & Launch** ($2,000): Strategy, creative, targeting, conversion tracking, and launch for one platform.
- **Ongoing Management** ($1,500/mo, highlighted): Multi-platform management, A/B testing, budget optimization, weekly reports, and monthly strategy calls.
- **Full-Stack: Ads + Landing Pages** ($5,000): Complete ad ecosystem — campaigns, landing pages, conversion tracking, and funnel optimization.

### How It Works
01. Audit — We analyze your current ad performance, tracking setup, creative assets, and competitive landscape.
02. Build — We create campaign strategy, ad creative, targeting audiences, and conversion tracking.
03. Launch — We launch campaigns with controlled budgets, A/B testing, and real-time monitoring.
04. Scale — Weekly optimization, budget scaling, creative refresh, and performance reporting.

### FAQ
- Which platforms do you manage? Google Ads (Search, Display, YouTube, Performance Max), Meta (Facebook, Instagram), LinkedIn, and TikTok.
- What's the minimum ad budget? We recommend at least $1,500/month in ad spend to generate meaningful data and results.
- Do you create the ad creative? Yes. We create ad copy, images, and video concepts. For video production, we partner with specialists when needed.
- Can you run bilingual campaigns? Yes. We run separate campaigns for English and Spanish audiences with native ad copy and culturally relevant creative.
- How do you report results? Weekly performance snapshots and monthly deep-dive reports with actionable recommendations.

## Dashboard Page

### Hero
**Headline:** Your Entire Business. One Screen.
**Subheadline:** Custom-built dashboards you own outright. No monthly SaaS fees. No vendor lock-in. Your data, your dashboard, your business.

### The Problem
Businesses juggle dozens of tools — analytics, CRM, marketing, operations — each with its own login, its own reports, and its own monthly fee. You spend hours compiling data from multiple sources instead of making decisions. And you don't own any of it.

### Tiers
- **Analytics Dashboard** ($3,000): Website analytics, traffic sources, conversion tracking, and custom KPI visualization — all in one view.
- **Marketing Command Center** ($6,000, highlighted): Analytics plus social media metrics, ad performance, email campaign data, SEO rankings, and lead pipeline — unified into a single command center.
- **Full Business Operations Dashboard** ($10,000): Everything above plus CRM data, scheduling, inventory, team performance, financial metrics, and custom integrations.
- **Ongoing Dashboard Support** ($500/mo): Monthly updates, new data source integrations, performance optimization, and priority support.

### How It Works
01. Discover — We map your data sources, KPIs, team workflows, and reporting needs.
02. Architect — We design your dashboard layout, data connections, and visualization strategy.
03. Build — We build your custom dashboard with real-time data connections, responsive design, and user training.
04. Deliver & Train — We hand over your dashboard with full documentation, video training, and 30 days of support.

### What Makes This Different
- **You Own It** — No monthly SaaS subscription. The dashboard is yours. Period.
- **No Monthly SaaS Fees** — One-time build cost. We hand over the code, the hosting, the data connections.
- **Custom-Built for Your Business** — Not a template. Not a plugin. Built specifically for how your business operates.
- **Real-Time Data** — Live connections to your actual data sources. Not exports. Not screenshots. Real-time.

### FAQ
- Do I really own the dashboard? Yes. Full code ownership, hosting credentials, and documentation. You can modify it, host it anywhere, or hire anyone to maintain it.
- What data sources can you connect? Google Analytics, social media APIs, CRM systems, ad platforms, email tools, payment processors, custom databases — virtually any system with an API.
- How is this different from Looker Studio or Tableau? Those are SaaS tools with monthly fees and limitations. We build custom dashboards tailored to your exact needs with no recurring costs.
- How long does the build take? Analytics dashboards: 2-3 weeks. Marketing command centers: 4-6 weeks. Full operations dashboards: 6-10 weeks.
- Can the dashboard be expanded later? Absolutely. The architecture is designed for growth. Add new data sources, new views, or new team members at any time.

## About Page

### Hero
**Headline:** We're Storytellers First. Technologists Second.
**Hook:** A boutique team based in San Miguel de Allende, building AI-powered business ecosystems for companies across Mexico and the United States.
We bring decades of experience in branding, creative direction, and technology — combined into systems that actually work for real businesses.

### Our Story
We started as storytellers and creative directors. Design, photography, video, brand strategy — that's our foundation. Over the years, we've added deep technology expertise to our toolkit. Now we build the complete package: the brand, the website, and the systems that power your business.

We believe the best technology is invisible. It should feel natural, work on your phone, and never make you feel like you need a computer science degree. That's why we lead with brand and creativity, then layer in the right technology to support it.

**Manifesto:** Beautiful brands deserve powerful systems. Powerful systems deserve beautiful brands.

### Why Mexico / Why San Miguel
Mexico is one of the fastest-moving markets in the world. A new wave of entrepreneurs, a growing middle class, and nearshoring investment are opening doors that did not exist five years ago. Many businesses are skipping legacy systems and jumping straight from paper to AI, and from word-of-mouth to full digital ecosystems.

San Miguel de Allende is our home. Beyond the beauty, it is a serious market: millions of visitors each year, a strong expat community, and local businesses competing for attention with weak digital presence. This city brings Mexican families, expats, travelers, and entrepreneurs into one place, so your brand has to speak to multiple audiences at once. That is the work we do best.

Construimos ecosistemas de negocio impulsados por inteligencia artificial — identidad de marca, sitios web, flujos de trabajo con IA y sistemas empresariales automatizados — para empresas en Mexico y Estados Unidos. Nuestro enfoque: la marca primero, tecnologia que funciona, transferencia completa de propiedad. Hablamos ingles y espanol de forma nativa.

Servicios: Servicios Profesionales (medicos, abogados, consultores, fotografos, artistas), Plataformas para Pequenos Negocios (restaurantes, hoteles, retail), y Empresarial y Operaciones (empresas en crecimiento, franquicias, operaciones complejas).
